signal_notation: R-VS9(3) 三件組 <signal> in <message> on <網段>（見上繳 15 §2.1 之衝突陳報）

tcs.tc_title: Stop-start enabled and engine stopped -> seat and steering wheel indicators off
tcs.test_item:
If the stop-start system is enabled the HMI shall turn off the heated/vented seats and the heated steering wheel switch indicators based on the $EngRun_Stat$ signal and the $ESS_ENG_ST$ signal.

(Stop-start enabled, engine stopped)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Activate the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches on the Climate screen
4. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 1 (ENS Stopped)
5. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 0 (Engine_Off) and check that the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are turned off
tcs.expected_result:
1. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running) is registered without a bus error
2. EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On) is registered without a bus error
3. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are lit
4. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 1 (ENS Stopped) is registered without a bus error
5. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are turned off

tcs.tc_title: ESS_ENG_ST monitored to attribute engine-state change to stop mode
tcs.test_item:
If the stop-start system is enabled the HMI shall monitor the $ESS_ENG_ST$ signal to determine if a change in $EngRun_Stat$ is a result of the vehicle entering stop mode.

(Engine-off attributed to stop mode, not to key-off)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 4 (ENS Stop Pending)
4. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 0 (Engine_Off)
5. Read ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B and check that it is 1 (ENS Stopped)
tcs.expected_result:
1. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running) is registered without a bus error
2. EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On) is registered without a bus error
3. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 4 (ENS Stop Pending) is registered without a bus error
4. EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 0 (Engine_Off) is registered without a bus error
5. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B reads 1 (ENS Stopped) while EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B reads 0 (Engine_Off)

tcs.tc_title: Stop mode with stop-start not disabled -> heat and vent switches stay active
tcs.test_item:
If ($EngRun_Stat$ <> [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ <> [ENS_DSBL] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ <> [SNA])then the HMI shall continue to activate all heat and vent switches currently active and allow the customer to select the switches.

(Stop mode, stop-start neither disabled nor SNA)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Activate all heat and vent switches on the Climate screen
3. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足不等條件之匯流排值
4. Check that all heat and vent switches remain active and selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running) is registered without a bus error
2. All heat and vent switches are lit
3. PENDING: DR-19
4. All heat and vent switches remain lit and respond to selection

tcs.tc_title: Stop mode with stop-start disabled -> heat and vent switches greyed out
tcs.test_item:
If ($EngRun_Stat$ <> [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ = [ENS_DSBL])then The HMI shall grey-out all heat and vent switches.

(Stop mode with stop-start disabled)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running)
2. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足不等條件之匯流排值
3. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 7 (ENS disabled) and check that all heat and vent switches are greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running) is registered without a bus error
2. PENDING: DR-19
3. All heat and vent switches are greyed out

tcs.tc_title: Engine running -> heat, vent and steering wheel switches activatable
tcs.test_item:
IF ($EngRun_Stat$ = [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN])then The HMI shall allow activation of the heated and vented seats and the heated steering wheel switches.

(Engine running)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足等於條件之匯流排值
2. Select the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches on the Climate screen and check that each switch activates
tcs.expected_result:
1. PENDING: DR-19
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches each change to the activated state

tcs.tc_title: ESS_ENG_ST = SNA -> stop-start restrictions not applied
tcs.test_item:
IF ($ESS_ENG_ST$ = [SNA])then The HMI shall behave as if the vehicle is not equipped with the Stop-Start system.

(Stop-start status signal not available)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
2. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Send ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 15 (SNA)
4. Send EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 0 (Engine_Off) and check that all heat and vent switches remain selectable and are not greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 3 (ENS Running) is registered without a bus error
2. EngineSts in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 2 (Engine_On) is registered without a bus error
3. ESS_ENG_ST in STATUS_CCAN3 on CAN-B = 15 (SNA) is registered without a bus error
4. All heat and vent switches remain selectable and are not greyed out

tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive without seat side labels -> LF request unchanged
tcs.test_item:
If there is no Driver or Passenger label for Heated and Vented seats, the $DriverSide$ signal value shall have no impact on the Heated and Vented seat switch behavior.

(Right-hand drive, no Driver or Passenger label)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated and vented seat switches carry no Driver or Passenger label
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
3. BH-CAN is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read FL_HS_Tlm in TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3 on BH-CAN and check that it is 0 (Not_Pressed)
2. Press the left front heated seat switch on the Climate screen and check that FL_HS_Tlm in TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3 on BH-CAN is 1 (Pressed)
tcs.expected_result:
1. FL_HS_Tlm in TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3 on BH-CAN reads 0 (Not_Pressed)
2. FL_HS_Tlm in TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3 on BH-CAN reads 1 (Pressed)

tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive configuration applied to the HMI
tcs.test_item:
If $DriverSide$ = [Right hand drive] the HMI shall be modified as defined by HMI requirements.

(Right-hand drive configuration accepted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
2. The Climate screen is reachable from the Menu Bar
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU so that PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) is applied
2. PENDING: DR-20 條文以「as defined by HMI requirements」交叉參照，未指名該 HMI 需求，無可判定之修改項
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up and the Climate screen is displayed
2. PENDING: DR-20

tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive with side labels -> driver and passenger labels swapped
tcs.test_item:
If there are Driver and Passenger labels for Heated and Vented seats, when $DriverSide$ = [Right Drive] the HMI shall: switch the labels of the driver and passenger heated/vented seats buttons.

(Right-hand drive with Driver and Passenger labels)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated and vented seat switches carry Driver and Passenger labels
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 0 (Left Side)
3. The Climate screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the labels of the heated and vented seat buttons and record which button carries "Driver"
2. Set PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
3. Power cycle the HU so that the configuration is applied
4. Read the labels of the heated and vented seat buttons and check that the "Driver" and "Passenger" labels have swapped sides compared with step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. The button carrying "Driver" is recorded
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) is accepted
3. The HU completes start-up and the Climate screen is displayed
4. The "Driver" and "Passenger" labels are on the opposite heated and vented seat buttons from those recorded in step 1

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump button lowers both third row head restraints together
tcs.test_item:
When the Headrest Dump Softkey button is pressed, the HMI shall simultaneously activate both left and right third-row head restraint dump functions. The left and right head restraint dump functions shall operate together and shall not be independently controlled.

(Single press, both restraints, lower only)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Both third row head restraints are in the raised position
2. The Headrest Dump Softkey button is shown and selectable
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the position of the left and right third row head restraints and record it
2. Press the "Headrest Dump" softkey button and check that both the left and the right third row head restraints lower
3. Press the "Headrest Dump" softkey button again and check that neither head restraint is raised
tcs.expected_result:
1. Both third row head restraints are recorded as raised
2. The left and the right third row head restraints lower at the same time
3. Both third row head restraints stay lowered

reasoning: 本批 10 條取自 Layer 2 = Common Features 之 42 個無阻塞 leaf，依 reqid 升冪。驗證目標為 Stop-Start 系統對加熱／通風開關之啟用與抑制、LHD/RHD 設定對座椅開關與標籤之影響、以及第三排頭枕下放之同動行為。關鍵情境條件以 CAN-B 之 ESS_ENG_ST 與 EngineSts、BH-CAN 之 FL_HS_Tlm、以及 PROXI Driver_Side 驅動，值一律取 DBC VAL_ 或 LID Format 逐字。切分依 §8.2.1 逐 leaf 一條，未將兄弟 Req 之行為併入：4858550 只驗訊號監看，其開關結果由 4858551／4858553 擁有；4858557 只驗未套用 stop-start 抑制，未涵蓋「未配備車輛」之完整行為（其定義於本 Req 之外，見 §8.4.2）。未涵蓋者：4858551／4858553／4858555 因 $EngRun_Stat$ 之 [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN] 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應值而以 PENDING: DR-19 佔位；4858560 因條文僅交叉參照未具名之 HMI 需求而以 PENDING: DR-20 佔位（§8.4.3）。
